replies.author: Netuxx
replies.body:
K/D is basicly your Kills divided by your Deaths (K = Kills, D = Deaths)
PvP K/D is basicly the amount of kills you did with a bow or a sword divided by your deaths.

For me, normaly a good K/D and PvP K/D is above 1.0. But i think yours is good too =)
If you want to increase your K/D you need to kill a lot without die.
